name: SmartSuite
desc: Collaborative work management platform combining databases with spreadsheets.

actions.name: create_record
actions.description: Creates a new record in the specified table.

actions.name: update_record
actions.description: Updates an existing record in the specified table

actions.name: delete_record
actions.description: Deletes a record from the specified table

actions.name: upload_file
actions.description: Uploads a file and attaches it to a record.

actions.name: find_records
actions.description: Searches for records in the specified table based on criteria.

actions.name: get_record
actions.description: Retrieves a specific record by ID

actions.name: list_solutions
actions.description: Lists the solutions (workspaces of tables) your account can access.

actions.name: get_solution
actions.description: Gets the details of one solution.

actions.name: list_tables
actions.description: Lists the tables in a solution.

actions.name: get_table_schema
actions.description: Gets a table and its fields (slug, label, type and choices).

actions.name: bulk_create_records
actions.description: Creates up to 25 records in one request.

actions.name: bulk_update_records
actions.description: Updates up to 25 records in one request.

actions.name: bulk_delete_records
actions.description: Deletes up to 25 records in one request.

actions.name: upsert_record
actions.description: Updates the record whose field matches a value, or creates it when none matches.

actions.name: list_deleted_records
actions.description: Lists the records in a solution's trash.

actions.name: restore_record
actions.description: Brings a deleted record back from the trash.

actions.name: list_comments
actions.description: Lists the comments on a record.

actions.name: add_comment
actions.description: Adds a comment to a record.

actions.name: list_members
actions.description: Lists the members of your SmartSuite workspace.

actions.name: get_member
actions.description: Gets one workspace member.

actions.name: list_teams
actions.description: Lists the teams in your SmartSuite workspace.

actions.name: download_record_file
actions.description: Gets temporary download links for the files in a record's Files & Images field.

actions.name: create_table
actions.description: Creates a new table in a solution.

actions.name: add_field
actions.description: Adds a new field (column) to a table.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_record
triggers.description: Triggers when a new record is created in the specified table

triggers.name: updated_record
triggers.description: Triggers when a record is updated in the specified table.
